**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/21 (Sun) 19:58  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Risks to the Builder:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Subclause 21.1: Failure to provide timely notice of practical completion may result in delay in receiving payment and/or liability for damages arising from the delay  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Subclause 21.2: Failure to accurately assess practical completion date may result in a dispute with the owner  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Subclause 21.3(a): Failure to complete the works to a satisfactory standard may result in the owner withholding payment  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Subclause 21.3(b): Additional work required to reach practical completion may result in delays and additional costs to the builder  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Subclause 21.5(i): Dispute resolution process may result in further delays and costs for the builder  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Subclause 21.5(ii): Suspension of work during dispute resolution process may result in further delays and costs for the builder  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Subclause 21.6: Non-payment of final progress claim may result in the builder pursuing legal action against the owner for debt recovery  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Risks to the Owner:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Subclause 21.1: Failure to receive timely notice of practical completion may result in delay in arranging an inspection  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Subclause 21.2: Dispute with builder over practical completion date may result in delay in arranging an inspection  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Subclause 21.3(a): Paying final progress claim before the work is complete may result in defects being overlooked  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Subclause 21.3(b): Dispute with builder over additional work required to reach practical completion may result in delays  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Subclause 21.5(i): Dispute resolution process may result in further delays and costs for the owner  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Subclause 21.5(ii): Suspension of work during dispute resolution process may result in further delays and costs for the owner  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Subclause 21.6: Non-payment of final progress claim may result in legal action being taken against the owner for debt recovery  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Note: These tables are not exhaustive and do not account for all possible risks or benefits. They are intended as a brief summary of some of the most significant risks and benefits associated with each subclause
